title: Zero Data Loss Promise vs 4 Hours RPO Spec
commitment: Our synchronous backup architecture guarantees zero data loss in the event of a regional outage.
proposal:
# Resilience
Our synchronous backup architecture guarantees zero data loss in the event of a regional outage.
technicalSpec:
# Disaster Recovery Spec
## 4.1 Backup Snapshots
Database snapshots run every 4 hours, resulting in a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 4 hours.
